description_en: Updates the information for a dataset acceleration slot
description_zh: 更新一个数据集加速槽的信息
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator update-slot --slot-id slot-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5 --name slot_1 --description XGBoost_dataset_acceleration_slot --tags Value=v0.1.0 Key=dataset_version --storage-type OSS --storage-uri oss://pai-vision-data-hz2.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/data/VOCdevkit/VOC2007/ImageSets/Main/val.txt --capacity 30.0G --life-cycle example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSlot

parameters.help_en: The slot ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽ID。如何获取数据集加速槽ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.name: slot_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the slot.
The name can be up to 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽名称。
长度限制为64个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the slot.
The description can be up to 1,024 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的描述与解释。
长度限制为1024个字符
parameters.name: description

element_fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.
The key can be up to 64 characters long
element_fields.help_zh:
标签的键值。
长度限制为64个字符
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.
The value can be up to 64 characters long
element_fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
长度限制为64个字符
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The custom tags for the slot
parameters.help_zh: 用户为数据集加速槽添加的自定义标签
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The data storage type for the slot. Valid values:

- OSS: OSS file storage.

- NAS: NAS file storage
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的数据存储类型，取值如下：
- OSS：OSS文件存储。
- NAS：NAS文件存储
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The resource identifier for the data in the slot. The format varies based on the data type
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽的数据的资源标识符，数据类型不同存在不同格式
parameters.name: storage_uri

parameters.help_en:
The maximum capacity of the slot.
The string must be in the format specified in [Quantity](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/common-definitions/quantity/)
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的最大容量。
输入字符串的格式需要满足以下规范：[Quantity](https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/common-definitions/quantity/)
parameters.name: capacity

fields.help_en:
The type of dataset acceleration slot lifecycle.

- KeepAlive: Keeps running and will not be released.
- RelativeTime: Released after running for a specified duration, in seconds.
- AbsoluteTime: Automatically released at the specified point in time.
- MaximumIdleTime: A relative time interval; if the difference between the last operation time and the current time exceeds this interval, the instance is released, in seconds.
fields.help_zh:
数据集加速槽生命周期类型。 

- KeepAlive：保持运行，不会被释放 。
- RelativeTime：运行一段时间后释放，单位为秒 。
- AbsoluteTime：运行到该时间点时，将会自动释放 。
- MaximumIdleTime：相对时间间隔，最后一次操作时间和当前时间差超过该间隔，即释放实例，单位为秒
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: Configuration of the dataset acceleration slot lifecycle. The structure of the configuration varies depending on the type. For more complex configuration requirements, it can be parsed as a JSON string.
fields.help_zh: 数据集加速槽生命周期配置，根据类型不同，配置结构也不同。 如果有更加复杂的配置需求，可以解析为Json String
fields.name: config

parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽的生命周期
parameters.name: life_cycle
